mapper.select: SELECT e.id, e.requirement_id, e.instance_id, e.transition_id, e.node_id, e.node_name, e.node_status_code, e.evaluator_id, COALESCE(u.real_name, u.username) AS evaluator_name, e.rating, e.content, e.created_at, ns.name AS node_status_name FROM requirement_approval_evaluations e LEFT JOIN users u ON e.evaluator_id = u.id LEFT JOIN node_statuses ns ON e.node_status_code = ns.code WHERE e.requirement_id = #{requirementId} ORDER BY e.created_at ASC, e.id ASC
